mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection( generation_id,source_id,cluster_id,source_channel,logical_channel,cluster_status,reported_at,function_module, province_code,city_code,application_name,region_value,attachment_count,screenshot_count,log_count, video_count,decision_type,match_similarity,decision_reason,ai_model,ai_confidence,ai_action,ai_explanation ) VALUES
(#{row.generationId},#{row.sourceId},#{row.clusterId},#{row.sourceChannel},#{row.logicalChannel},#{row.clusterStatus}, #{row.reportedAt},#{row.functionModule},#{row.provinceCode},#{row.cityCode},#{row.applicationName}, #{row.regionValue},#{row.attachmentCount},#{row.screenshotCount},#{row.logCount},#{row.videoCount}, #{row.decisionType},#{row.matchSimilarity},#{row.decisionReason},#{row.aiModel},#{row.aiConfidence}, #{row.aiAction},#{row.aiExplanation})
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cluster_id=incoming.cluster_id,source_channel=incoming.source_channel, logical_channel=incoming.logical_channel,cluster_status=incoming.cluster_status, reported_at=incoming.reported_at,function_module=incoming.function_module, province_code=incoming.province_code,city_code=incoming.city_code,application_name=incoming.application_name, region_value=incoming.region_value,attachment_count=incoming.attachment_count, screenshot_count=incoming.screenshot_count,log_count=incoming.log_count,video_count=incoming.video_count, decision_type=incoming.decision_type,match_similarity=incoming.match_similarity, decision_reason=incoming.decision_reason,ai_model=incoming.ai_model,ai_confidence=incoming.ai_confidence, ai_action=incoming.ai_action,ai_explanation=incoming.ai_explanation, projected_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT generation_id,source_id,cluster_id,source_channel,logical_channel,cluster_status,reported_at,function_module, province_code,city_code,application_name,region_value,attachment_count,screenshot_count,log_count, video_count,decision_type,match_similarity,decision_reason,ai_model,ai_confidence,ai_action,ai_explanation FROM t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_member_projection WHERE generation_id=#{generationId} AND source_id>#{afterSourceId} ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit}
